review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Reporting to the Manager of Network Services, the Network Engineer is responsible for supporting, operating, and evolving enterprise network infrastructure across on-prem and cloud environments. This role focuses on reliable day-to-day operations, troubleshooting, and incremental improvements to network services, while contributing to standards, documentation, and planned technology upgrades. Support, operate, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure in accordance with established standard
eligibility_evidence: Support hybrid network connectivity, including on-prem network elements and cloud networking components (Azure).
Experience supporting hybrid connectivity (site-to-site VPNs, remote access, cloud integration).
Most office-based roles follow a hybrid model, with the option to work remotely two days a week.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: 5+ years of experience in IT infrastructure or network engineering roles. Hands-on operational experience with Cisco networking technologies such as SD-WAN, Catalyst, ACI, and wireless infrastructure.
